# BtechWaleTech

> BtechWaleTech is a group of three freelance developers in India who build websites, Android and iOS apps, custom software, SEO systems, ecommerce stores, AI automations, AI agents, and data analysis workflows for small businesses, startups, creators, and service providers. It serves clients across all 28 states and 8 union territories of India, from metro cities like Delhi, Mumbai, Bengaluru, Hyderabad, Chennai, Kolkata, and Pune to Tier-2 and Tier-3 cities, and works remotely with clients in the USA, UK, Canada, Australia, UAE, Singapore, and Europe. Pricing starts at ₹10,000 for a static website.

Canonical website: [https://btechwaletech.in/](https://btechwaletech.in/)
Email: [info@btechwaletech.in](mailto:info@btechwaletech.in)
Phone and WhatsApp: +91 62069 86683 ([https://wa.me/916206986683](https://wa.me/916206986683))

## Quick Facts

- Brand name: BtechWaleTech (also written as "Btech Wale Tech")
- Business type: freelance group of three developers (web development, apps, SEO, AI automation)
- Headquarters country: India
- Service area: all of India (remote delivery, pan-India) plus international clients
- Currency: INR for Indian clients, USD for international clients
- Delivery model: 100% remote, with calls on WhatsApp, Google Meet, or Zoom
- Ideal clients: small businesses, local shops, clinics, coaching institutes, schools, real estate firms, manufacturers, D2C brands, startups, agencies, creators, and freelancers
- Maintenance: first 5 months free after launch

## Services

- [Website development](https://btechwaletech.in/services/web-development/): Business websites, static websites, landing pages, portfolio sites, multi-page company websites, and fast mobile-friendly websites built on Astro, React, Next.js, and WordPress.
- [SEO services](https://btechwaletech.in/services/seo-services/): Technical SEO, local SEO, on-page SEO, schema markup, sitemap and robots setup, Core Web Vitals and page speed fixes, internal linking, keyword research, content planning, and Google Search Console setup.
- Programmatic SEO websites: Large sites with 700+ location or service pages built to rank for "service + city" searches across India.
- AI and GEO optimization: Making websites visible in Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, and Claude through structured data, llms.txt, clear entity information, and answer-first content.
- [Android and iOS app development](https://btechwaletech.in/it-services/android-ios-app/): Mobile apps for Android and iPhone built once in Flutter or React Native and published to Google Play and the Apple App Store. Includes login, payments (Stripe, Razorpay, UPI, Apple Pay, Google Pay), push notifications, maps, offline mode, AI features, backend API, and a web admin panel. Startup MVPs, ecommerce, booking, delivery, and staff apps for clients in the USA, UK, Canada, Australia, UAE, Singapore, Europe, and India.
- Ecommerce development: Online stores with product catalogs, carts, Razorpay, UPI, Stripe, and PayPal payments, order management, and Shopify or custom builds.
- Custom software and web apps: Dashboards, CRMs, booking systems, portals, SaaS MVPs, admin panels, and internal business tools.
- AI automation and AI agents: WhatsApp chatbots, lead capture automation, AI customer support agents, n8n and Zapier workflows, document processing, and LLM integrations using OpenAI, Claude, and Gemini.
- Data analysis: Reporting dashboards, Excel and Google Sheets automation, Python data pipelines, and business analytics.
- Deployment and hosting: Domain setup, cloud hosting on AWS, Vercel, Netlify, and Cloudflare, SSL, business email, and CI/CD.
- Website maintenance: Updates, backups, security patches, uptime monitoring, and content changes on a monthly plan.
- [Hire IT freelancers](https://btechwaletech.in/freelancers/): A team of three IT freelancers in India (full stack, AI and cloud, project and automation) hired directly, with no marketplace fees, as freelance web developers, app developers, SEO experts, AI and automation engineers, data analysts and cloud engineers. Roles, starting prices, a vetting checklist and hiring from abroad.
- [Freelancing IT services](https://btechwaletech.in/freelancing/): How freelancing works for businesses buying IT work: project steps, Upwork, Fiverr, Freelancer.com and Toptal compared, fixed-price vs hourly vs retainer, milestone payments, contracts, code ownership and a handover checklist.

## How a Project Works

1. Free consultation on WhatsApp or a call to understand goals, budget, and timeline.
2. Written scope and fixed quote with pages, features, and delivery date.
3. Design and development with regular previews.
4. SEO setup before launch: metadata, schema, sitemap, speed, and Search Console.
5. Launch, handover, and free maintenance for the first 5 months.

Typical timelines: static website 1 to 2 weeks, AI automation 2 to 4 weeks, SEO website 3 to 5 weeks, ecommerce store 4 to 8 weeks, Android and iOS app 6 to 10 weeks, and custom web app or software 6 to 12 weeks, depending on scope.
